test_title: PYST 67: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

We took dinner in a Chinese restaurant and were amazed to see the interior of a restaurant.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The error lies in the use of the article in the phrase "**the interior of a restaurant**." 
 
• The sentence already mentions a specific restaurant: "**a Chinese restaurant**." 
 
• When referring back to the same restaurant, the definite article "**the**" should be used instead of "**a**." 
 
• Therefore, "**a restaurant**" should be replaced with "**the restaurant**." 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 

 

**Correct Sentence:** * "We took dinner in a Chinese restaurant and were amazed to see the interior of **the restaurant**." * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 1:** "and were amazed to see" – grammatically correct. 
 
• **Option 3:** "We took dinner" – acceptable usage in Indian English. 
 
• **Option 4:** "in a Chinese restaurant" – grammatically correct.
